question: In May 2025, Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi has approved the setting up of ______ National Centres of Excellence for Skilling as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **May 2025**, Prime Minister **Shri Narendra Modi** approved the establishment of **5 National Centres of Excellence for Skilling** as a **Centrally Sponsored Scheme**.
 
• The aim of these centers is to enhance **skilling infrastructure** and provide high-quality, industry-relevant training to the youth of India.
 
• The initiative aligns with the **Skill India Mission**, which seeks to equip Indian youth with employable skills and bridge the gap between education and employment.
 
• The scheme is centrally sponsored, meaning the **funding is shared between the central government and state governments**, ensuring collaborative implementation.
 
• The focus of these centers will be on **innovation, technology-driven learning, and industry partnerships** to ensure maximum employability of trained individuals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Skill India Mission:**

 
 
• Launched by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** in **2015**, the Skill India initiative aims to train over **40 crore individuals** in various skills by **2022**.
 
• It includes programs like **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)** and **National Skill Development Mission**.
 
• The mission focuses on improving **vocational education, skill development, and entrepreneurship opportunities**.
 
 
 
• **National Centres of Excellence for Skilling:**
 
 
• These centers are strategically set up to offer specialized training in emerging sectors such as **Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Renewable Energy, Healthcare, and IT**.
 
• The centers will collaborate with **industry experts** to design curriculum and provide hands-on experience.
 
• The goal is to make India a global hub for **skilled manpower**, supporting economic growth and innovation.
 
 
 
• **Centrally Sponsored Schemes:**
 
 
• A Centrally Sponsored Scheme involves financial contributions from both the **central and state governments**.
 
• Examples include **PMAY (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana)**, **MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act)**, etc.
 
• These schemes aim to promote **development and welfare** across various sectors like **education, health, and infrastructure**.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Skilling Initiatives:**
 
 
• India has one of the youngest populations globally, with a median age of **28 years**, making skilling programs critical for **employment generation**.
 
• Skilled manpower contributes to higher productivity, innovation, and economic growth.
 
• Initiatives like these help address challenges such as **unemployment** and **underemployment**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of National Centres of Excellence for Skilling:**

 
 
• Focus on **high-demand sectors** such as **IT, Renewable Energy, Healthcare, and Industry 4.0 technologies**.
 
• Promotes **public-private partnerships** for skill training and job placement.
 
• Emphasizes **hands-on training** to ensure industry readiness.
 
• Supports the **Make in India** and **Atmanirbhar Bharat** initiatives by creating a workforce aligned with global demands.
 
 
 
• **Related Government Schemes:**
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY):** Offers free skill training to enhance employability.
 
• **National Skill Development Mission:** Focuses on improving overall skill development infrastructure.
 
• **Skill India Digital Platform:** Provides online learning resources for vocational training.
